Made-up sentences in the shape of the Tatoeba exports (`per_language/jpn/…`,
`jpn_indices`), for tools/dict/build_examples.py --sample-sql and its tests.
The words are real JMdict words of packages/dict_jmdict's test fixture; the
sentences, translations and user names are invented. Sentence 999 has no text
(an index row of a sentence that is gone).
